scope: Twenty distinct bounded acceptance checks for strict authored DevOps configuration and prepared native validation. This is a verification record, not a corpus precision estimate.

toolchainNotes: Pinned uv 0.12.18; native tools available through the Standards virtual environment; writable temporary uv cache.
limitations: This is the local canonical gate. Its private-reference scan is delegated to trusted CI; remote GitHub CI was not run.
fullRepositoryVerification.sourceTreeState: Historical collaborative working tree identified by gitHead, treeState and evidenceFilesSha256; includes unrelated concurrent work excluded from this PR.

commandCapture: Commands are relative to the repository root. Pytest capture used an additional temporary --junitxml report path; replayable argv omits only that report-path option. Counts are actual collected passing cases, not estimated counts. These commands describe the historical collaborative tree. The quality-check argv includes five concurrent Python rules intentionally excluded from the isolated PR; its replay requires that historical tree. The isolated branch is verified separately.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Execution program classification across supported consumers, excluding Dockerfile-specific build-context ignore files
limitations: Labeled fixtures establish the selected execution-field contract; they do not establish all configuration dialects or corpus precision.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Native shell AST distinguishes one invocation from executable source/control flow
limitations: The supported shell AST and interpreter grammar is bounded. Unknown grammar is a coverage issue; scripts are never executed.

passes.acceptanceCheck: YAML aliases/merges/documents and baseline payload identity preserve authored use sites
limitations: These are source projection and baseline-identity tests, not a full baseline migration or consumer rollout test.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Malformed or unresolved executable input remains unsuppressible coverage failure
limitations: The tests verify known unprovable classes; arbitrary generated syntax is not evaluated or silently accepted.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Build dependency/exclusivity rules, YAML use-site provenance and bounded composition/expanded work with fatal recursive input
limitations: SARJ315 is a narrow step contract, not complete Cloud Build API schema, trigger option or effective identity validation.
Unselected malformed YAML belongs to the YAML engine. Parser failures are not semantic baseline findings.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Build-time shell source substitutions versus escaped runtime environment/direct argv
limitations: Only documented non-overridable PROJECT_ID and BUILD_ID are safe builtins. This does not validate application script behavior or consumer substitution values.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Managed service-account key resources versus nonmanaged/unknown forms
limitations: Rejects literal google_service_account_key resource management only. No claim of complete IAM credential policy coverage.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Project Owner/Editor role proof, list/jsonencode/policy forms and scope exclusions
limitations: Allows Viewer/admin and organization/folder policies; unresolved role expressions abstain. Labeled cases do not establish corpus precision.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Actionlint and Zizmor strict machine protocol, byte coordinates and ignored native findings
limitations: Most protocol cases use injected runners. These test selected native audits and parsing, not every upstream audit or live workflow execution.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Hadolint Dockerfile variant/ignore selection and strict Hadolint/Terraform/TFLint protocols without implicit initialization
limitations: Injected protocol checks do not initialize provider graphs or validate cloud infrastructure. Trust/preinitialized inputs are required for provider validation.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Explicit consumer Compose pin and static no-interpolation/no-env-resolution checks
limitations: Static validation only. Effective Compose model, runtime environment resolution, secrets, deployment and Docker daemon behavior are not checked.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Prepared target declarations, source freshness, artifact containment and hashes
limitations: Receipt fixtures prove local admission invariants. They do not generate releases, contact clusters or establish provenance beyond the checked closed input contract.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Rendered Kubernetes identity, schema coverage and actual Helm install/upgrade ordinary-hook security validation
limitations: The two Helm hook cases execute real pinned native static tools; other native-report cases use injected reports. No Helm release is installed/upgraded and no cluster or cloud API is contacted.

realNativeChecks.observed: Both ordinary Pod hooks retained the expected missing allowPrivilegeEscalation security finding.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Cloud Run Service/Job exact supported GVK, local hashed schema binding and tamper/unknown/open-reference failures
limitations: Tests use fixture-supplied local closed schemas. This does not establish complete official Cloud Run API schemas or perform cloud-side deployment validation.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Native schema defaults, declared dialects, legacy IDs, pointers and data-vs-schema references
limitations: Closed local schemas only; unknown dialects/base reinterpretation are rejected. No remote schema retrieval or future dialect coverage is claimed.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Helm chart dependencies, archive safety/bounds and semantic local schema closure
limitations: Archive and schema admission tests do not prove chart rendering in every Helm version or cluster environment.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Pinned Skaffold v4beta7 and partial Cloud Deploy v1 source structure with bounded alias composition before construction
limitations: Cloud Deploy is explicitly partial: documented known fields only, unknown fields permitted. No deployment validation; unsupported reviewed schema versions are coverage failures.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Tools-only setup, Dockerfile variant/ignore native provisioning, manifest/file preservation and honest skipped work
limitations: Installer dispatch is intercepted in unit cases. This does not publish packages, run GitHub CI remotely or establish complete consumer rollout.

passes.acceptanceCheck: Real pinned Semgrep paired-fixture admission rejects obsolete version-key assumptions
limitations: Rejected integration: three exact upstream rules miss all three dangerous versionless Compose cases. Semgrep remains audit-only; no default security coverage is advertised.

passes.acceptanceCheck: All registered Python rules, strict Ruff, package type checks and authored rule-family file conventions on maintained semantic/admission source and focused tests
limitations: This is a bounded maintained-source scope, not the full repository make verify gate. Other package, TypeScript, wheel/release and generated artifact checks remain owned by the final repository verification.
The twenty acceptance checks group related concrete assertions; they are not twenty independent research agents or a proof that all possible configurations are covered.
The local full make verify gate passed separately from the twenty bounded acceptance checks; trusted CI-only checks remain delegated.
Compose coverage is static only. Effective-model/environment resolution coverage was not requested or run.
Cloud Deploy coverage is partial and Skaffold coverage is pinned to the reviewed v4beta7 schema. SARJ315 is a narrow Cloud Build step/substitution contract, not the entire cloud API.
Positive/negative fixtures do not establish corpus-wide precision. The remaining reviewed-corpus substitution candidates are not all individually adjudicated.
No publishing, merging, remote GitHub CI, releases, cluster admission, cloud API calls or deployments were performed for these acceptance checks.
The Semgrep admission check passed by confirming a coverage gap; the three candidates were rejected for default integration.
